title: synthetic truth: int x^(2eps)(1+x)^(-2-3eps) dx = B(1+2eps,1+eps); zeta(3) at eps^3
notes: Synthetic-truth positive control with eps-DEPENDENT exponents (exercises the EpsExp schema and multi-order Laurent comparison).
